## Summary

<!-- One or two sentences: what does this change do, and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix in existing code or documentation
- [ ] Reproducibility improvement (pinned versions, cleaner setup, one-command run)
- [ ] Documentation improvement (clarity, attribution, scope, accessibility)
- [ ] New tests for existing code
- [ ] New project (lab / research note / tool)
- [ ] Other — describe below

## Scope check

- [ ] The change is inside the repository's
      [responsible-use boundaries](../README.md#responsible-use).
- [ ] The change does not add offensive tooling, malware, or
      credential-harvesting code.
- [ ] Any new claim is backed by evidence in this repository (code + tests,
      a reproducible measurement, a worked example, or a verifiable citation).
      See [Research integrity](../docs/research-integrity.md).

## Reproducibility

- [ ] For new code: pinned language and dependency versions.
- [ ] For new code: at least a smoke test or documented sanity check.
- [ ] For new projects: a `Reproduce` section in the project's README.

## Attribution

- [ ] Third-party code, data, figures, or text used are credited with source
      and license, per the [attribution policy](../README.md#attribution-policy).
- [ ] If AI assistants materially contributed to a non-trivial component,
      that is noted in the affected project's README.

## Verification summary

- [ ] If this PR lands a project, [`docs/verification-summary.md`](../docs/verification-summary.md)
      is updated in the same PR.
